replacements.IA vs. humanos: el mapa es desigual: AI vs humans: the map is uneven
replacements.No existe un único “nivel humano”. Compa: There is no single “human level”. Compare a few representative domains to see where the benchmark has already fallen and where it remains open.
replacements.Deep Blue cruzó la referencia humana; lo: Deep Blue crossed the human benchmark; current engines are far above it.
replacements.ResNet cruzó el error humano de referenc: ResNet crossed the reference human error rate in image classification.
replacements.AlphaFold2 alcanzó precisión cercana a m: AlphaFold2 reached accuracy close to experimental methods on CASP14.
replacements.Modelos frontier han reportado rendimien: Frontier models have reported gold-medal performance in recent Olympiads.
replacements.El rendimiento sube rápido, pero sigue d: Performance is rising quickly, but still depends heavily on the environment, harness, and task duration.
replacements.La frontera se ha movido con rapidez, pe: The frontier has moved quickly, but the benchmark is not equivalent to a complete definition of AGI.
replacements.El horizonte de tareas fiables sigue muy: The horizon of reliable tasks remains far below a worker who maintains context for days or weeks.
replacements.Texto y benchmarks no sustituyen percepc: Text and benchmarks do not replace physical perception, robust action, and continuous learning in open environments.
replacements.La conclusión no es “la IA supera al hum: The conclusion is not “AI surpasses humans”. It is that different benchmarks fall at very different rates.
